name: klip-web
description: Klip Web — Exact web version of the Klip Kosher Jewish Clips & Simchas app

scripts.build: npx --yes vite build && node -e "fs.cpSync('assets', 'dist/assets', {recursive: true}); fs.mkdirSync('dist/js', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('js/hls.min.js', 'dist/js/hls.min.js'); fs.copyFileSync('_headers', 'dist/_headers'); if (fs.existsSync('robots.txt')) fs.copyFileSync('robots.txt', 'dist/robots.txt');"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name klip
